During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used a '''chemical''' to optimize the [[Water/Legends|waters]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] for breeding [[dovin basal]]s. It was released via a swarm of motile spheres deployed from [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]].
